Lead Time: New processing activity recorded within 10 business days of intake.
SLA Response Target: Privacy intake acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Record or determination completed within 15 business days
Escalation Path: A processing activity with no lawful basis or purpose escalates to the privacy lead and legal before launch.
Threats Addressed: Inability to answer regulators, unknown processing, and unmanaged personal data use.
KPIs and Metrics: Processes with a current record, records attested on time, and records missing required fields.

Name: Lawful Basis Determination
Summary: Assess and document the lawful basis for each processing purpose, including legitimate interest assessments.
Description: Privacy records the basis for every purpose before processing starts, with legal review where needed. Consent wording is drafted in consent management.
In Scope: Assessing and documenting the lawful basis for each processing purpose, including legitimate interest assessments.
Out of Scope: Drafting consent wording, contract negotiation, and legal opinions for litigation.
Deliverables: A lawful basis record per purpose, legitimate interest assessments, and a decisions log.
Prerequisites: A defined purpose, data categories, and legal review where needed.
Lead Time: New processing activity recorded within 10 business days of intake.
SLA Response Target: Privacy intake acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Record or determination completed within 15 business days
Escalation Path: A processing activity with no lawful basis or purpose escalates to the privacy lead and legal before launch.
Threats Addressed: Processing without a valid basis, reliance on invalid consent, and regulatory fines.
KPIs and Metrics: Purposes with a documented basis, assessments overdue for review, and decisions changed after challenge.

Name: Purpose Specification
Summary: Write clear, limited purposes for each processing activity and check new uses against them.
Description: Specific purpose statements make it possible to test whether a new use is compatible, which stops function creep before it starts.
In Scope: Writing clear, limited purposes for each processing activity and checking new uses against them.
Out of Scope: Product strategy, analytics model approval, and marketing campaign design.
Deliverables: Purpose statements per activity, a compatibility check record for new uses, and a purpose change log.
Prerequisites: Process owner input, existing notices, and the records of processing register.
Lead Time: New processing activity recorded within 10 business days of intake.
SLA Response Target: Privacy intake acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Record or determination completed within 15 business days
Escalation Path: A processing activity with no lawful basis or purpose escalates to the privacy lead and legal before launch.
Threats Addressed: Function creep, use of data beyond what people were told, and incompatible secondary use.
KPIs and Metrics: Activities with specific purposes, new uses checked before launch, and incompatible uses found.

Name: Privacy Requirements Definition
Summary: Turn privacy principles and laws into concrete requirements for products, systems, and projects.
Description: Projects get a requirements set at design time, covering things like deletion, export, and minimization, and the set is traced to launch.
In Scope: Translating privacy principles and laws into concrete requirements for products, systems, and projects.
Out of Scope: Writing the code, security requirements, and legal contract terms.
Deliverables: A privacy requirements set per project, a requirements traceability record, and reusable requirement patterns.
Prerequisites: A project scope, data flows, and the applicable privacy standard.
Lead Time: Privacy review starts within 5 business days of a complete project intake.
SLA Response Target: Review request acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Review findings within 10 business days of design materials
Escalation Path: A launch with unresolved high privacy risk escalates to the privacy lead and the product owner before release.
Threats Addressed: Products that collect too much, lack deletion features, or ignore user rights.
KPIs and Metrics: Projects with privacy requirements at design, requirements met at launch, and late requirement changes.

Name: Privacy Design Review
Summary: Review designs and material changes for privacy risk, with a privacy impact assessment where required.
Description: The review names the mitigations a design needs and triggers a formal impact assessment for high-risk processing, before launch rather than after a complaint.
In Scope: Reviewing designs and changes for privacy risk, including privacy impact assessments where required.
Out of Scope: Security architecture review, legal approval, and testing the build.
Deliverables: A privacy review report, a privacy impact assessment where triggered, and required mitigations.
Prerequisites: Design documents, data flows, and the project owner.
Lead Time: Privacy review starts within 5 business days of a complete project intake.
SLA Response Target: Review request acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Review findings within 10 business days of design materials
Escalation Path: A launch with unresolved high privacy risk escalates to the privacy lead and the product owner before release.
Threats Addressed: High-risk processing launched without assessment and privacy harms to individuals.
KPIs and Metrics: Reviews completed before launch, assessments triggered, and mitigations implemented.

Name: Privacy-Enhancing Technology Selection
Summary: Advise on and select privacy-enhancing technologies such as pseudonymization, differential privacy, or secure enclaves.
Description: For a given use case, the service compares options and recommends one that keeps the analytic value while reducing exposure of raw personal data. Engineering builds it.
In Scope: Advising on and selecting privacy-enhancing technologies, such as pseudonymization, differential privacy, or secure enclaves.
Out of Scope: Building the technology, procurement contracts, and data science model development.
Deliverables: A PET options analysis, a selection recommendation, and implementation guidance.
Prerequisites: A use case, data sensitivity, and engineering capacity.
Lead Time: Privacy review starts within 5 business days of a complete project intake.
SLA Response Target: Review request acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Review findings within 10 business days of design materials
Escalation Path: A launch with unresolved high privacy risk escalates to the privacy lead and the product owner before release.
Threats Addressed: Re-identification of analytics data and unnecessary exposure of raw personal data.
KPIs and Metrics: Use cases using PETs, re-identification tests passed, and adoption across teams.

Name: Notice Drafting
Summary: Draft privacy notices for customers, employees, and applicants that match what actually happens to their data.
Description: Every notice is cross-checked against the processing records and reviewed for plain language before legal approval.
In Scope: Drafting privacy notices for customers, employees, and applicants that match actual processing.
Out of Scope: Website design, marketing copy, and legal approval of terms of service.
Deliverables: Draft notices, a processing-to-notice cross-check, and a plain-language review record.
Prerequisites: Records of processing, legal input, and channel owner.
Lead Time: Notice drafting or update within 15 business days of request.
SLA Response Target: Notice request acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Approved notice published within 20 business days
Escalation Path: A notice that does not match actual processing escalates to the privacy lead and legal.
Threats Addressed: Misleading notices, missing disclosures, and regulatory complaints.
KPIs and Metrics: Notices matching processing records, readability score, and complaints about notices.

Name: Notice Delivery
Summary: Make sure notices appear at the right time and place, such as at collection, sign-up, and in apps.
Description: A placement map shows each collection point and the notice it should show, and gaps are fixed with the channel owner.
In Scope: Making sure notices are shown at the right time and place, such as at collection, sign-up, and in apps.
Out of Scope: Drafting notice content, consent management platform operation, and website hosting.
Deliverables: A notice placement map, delivery evidence per channel, and a gap report.
Prerequisites: Approved notices, channel owners, and collection point inventory.
Lead Time: Notice drafting or update within 15 business days of request.
SLA Response Target: Notice request acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Approved notice published within 20 business days
Escalation Path: A notice that does not match actual processing escalates to the privacy lead and legal.
Threats Addressed: Collection without notice and notices buried where people cannot find them.
KPIs and Metrics: Collection points with notice, missing placements, and time to fix gaps.

Name: Notice Version Management
Summary: Version, archive, and log changes to privacy notices so the version in force on any date can be shown.
Description: An archive with a change log proves what people were told and when, and material changes are notified as required.
In Scope: Version control, archival, and change logs for privacy notices so the notice in force at any time can be shown.
Out of Scope: Website content management, legal hold decisions, and drafting new notices.
Deliverables: A notice version archive, a change log, and a material change notification record.
Prerequisites: A content repository, publishing workflow, and legal approval.
Lead Time: Notice drafting or update within 15 business days of request.
SLA Response Target: Notice request acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Approved notice published within 20 business days
Escalation Path: A notice that does not match actual processing escalates to the privacy lead and legal.
Threats Addressed: Inability to prove what people were told and unannounced material changes.
KPIs and Metrics: Notices with full version history, material changes notified, and archive gaps.

Name: Consent Capture
Summary: Capture valid, specific, recorded consent where it is required, with proof of what was agreed.
Description: Consent records hold the timestamp, the wording version, and the channel, so consent can be proven. Pre-ticked boxes and bundled consent are not accepted.
In Scope: Capturing valid, specific, recorded consent where required, with proof of what was agreed and when.
Out of Scope: Notice drafting, marketing strategy, and lawful basis decisions.
Deliverables: A consent capture standard, consent records with timestamps and versions, and a capture audit report.
Prerequisites: A consent management tool, channel integration, and approved consent wording.
Lead Time: New channel integrated with consent records within 15 business days.
SLA Response Target: Consent platform issue acknowledged within 4 business hours
SLA Resolution Target: Withdrawal honored within 2 business days / platform fault fixed within 1 business day
Escalation Path: Processing that continues after a withdrawal, or consent records lost, escalates to the privacy lead and the system owner.
Threats Addressed: Invalid consent, pre-ticked boxes, and inability to prove consent.
KPIs and Metrics: Consents with complete records, capture audit failures, and channels integrated.

Name: Consent Withdrawal Processing
Summary: Process consent withdrawals across every system so processing stops promptly.
Description: A withdrawal reaches all downstream systems and is confirmed per system. A weekly backlog report catches anything still processing.
In Scope: Processing withdrawals across all systems so processing stops promptly and is recorded.
Out of Scope: Account deletion requests, marketing list hygiene for other reasons, and customer support scripting.
Deliverables: A withdrawal processing procedure, propagation records per system, and a weekly withdrawal backlog report.
Prerequisites: Consent records, system integrations, and support channel routing.
Lead Time: New channel integrated with consent records within 15 business days.
SLA Response Target: Consent platform issue acknowledged within 4 business hours
SLA Resolution Target: Withdrawal honored within 2 business days / platform fault fixed within 1 business day
Escalation Path: Processing that continues after a withdrawal, or consent records lost, escalates to the privacy lead and the system owner.
Threats Addressed: Continued marketing after opt-out, complaints, and regulatory fines.
KPIs and Metrics: Withdrawals processed within SLA, systems still processing after withdrawal, and complaints.

Name: Preference Management
Summary: Run a preference center where people manage communication and data-use choices that systems actually honor.
Description: Preferences sync to the CRM and marketing platforms, and sync errors are worked until they are resolved. Marketing content is out of scope.
In Scope: A preference center where people manage communication and data use choices that systems actually honor.
Out of Scope: Marketing content, CRM administration, and email delivery operations.
Deliverables: A preference center, a preference sync status report, and a preference change audit log.
Prerequisites: A preference platform, integrations to downstream systems, and channel owners.
Lead Time: New channel integrated with consent records within 15 business days.
SLA Response Target: Consent platform issue acknowledged within 4 business hours
SLA Resolution Target: Withdrawal honored within 2 business days / platform fault fixed within 1 business day
Escalation Path: Processing that continues after a withdrawal, or consent records lost, escalates to the privacy lead and the system owner.
Threats Addressed: Ignored preferences, inconsistent choices across systems, and loss of customer trust.
KPIs and Metrics: Preference sync success rate, preference changes honored, and sync errors resolved.

Name: Tracking Technology Inventory
Summary: Inventory cookies, pixels, SDKs, and tags on websites and apps, with owner, purpose, and recipient.
Description: Regular scans find every tracker and map it to a vendor, a purpose, and an owner. Unknown trackers are raised for removal.
In Scope: Inventory of cookies, pixels, SDKs, and tags on websites and apps, with owner, purpose, and recipient.
Out of Scope: Marketing analytics strategy, tag management platform administration, and web performance.
Deliverables: A tracker inventory, an unapproved tracker report, and a purpose and vendor mapping.
Prerequisites: Site and app scanning tools, tag manager access, and marketing owner contacts.
Lead Time: New site or app added to tracking scans within 10 business days.
SLA Response Target: Unapproved tracker finding acknowledged within 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Unapproved tracker removed or blocked within 5 business days
Escalation Path: A tracker that sends personal data to an unapproved third party escalates to the privacy lead and the site owner.
Threats Addressed: Hidden third-party trackers, data leaking to ad networks, and unlawful tracking.
KPIs and Metrics: Trackers with an owner and purpose, unknown trackers found, and inventory freshness.

Name: Cookie Consent Enforcement
Summary: Make sure non-essential cookies and tags fire only after consent and stop after refusal.
Description: Testing checks real behavior on each site against the banner choice, and misfiring tags are fixed with the site owner.
In Scope: Making sure non-essential cookies and tags only fire after consent and stop after refusal.
Out of Scope: Banner design copy, marketing measurement strategy, and app store compliance.
Deliverables: Consent enforcement test results, a misfiring tag report, and fix tickets.
Prerequisites: A consent banner or CMP, tag manager rules, and scanning tools.
Lead Time: New site or app added to tracking scans within 10 business days.
SLA Response Target: Unapproved tracker finding acknowledged within 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Unapproved tracker removed or blocked within 5 business days
Escalation Path: A tracker that sends personal data to an unapproved third party escalates to the privacy lead and the site owner.
Threats Addressed: Tracking without consent, regulator sweeps, and class action claims.
KPIs and Metrics: Tags firing before consent, sites passing enforcement tests, and fix time.

Name: Personal Data Identification
Summary: Find which systems and datasets hold personal data, using discovery results and owner input.
Description: Discovery findings and owner confirmation give a reliable list of personal data systems, which rights requests and breach scoping depend on.
In Scope: Finding which systems and datasets hold personal data using discovery results and owner input.
Out of Scope: General sensitive data discovery, records retention, and data quality.
Deliverables: A personal data system list, personal data elements per system, and a new findings report.
Prerequisites: Discovery scan results, system owners, and the records of processing register.
Lead Time: New system added to the personal data inventory within 10 business days.
SLA Response Target: Inventory question acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Inventory update within 10 business days of a change
Escalation Path: Special-category data found in a system with no approval escalates to the privacy lead and the system owner.
Threats Addressed: Unknown personal data stores and unanswered rights requests.
KPIs and Metrics: Systems assessed for personal data, new stores found, and owner confirmations.

Name: Personal Data Categorization
Summary: Group personal data into categories such as contact, financial, identifiers, and location.
Description: A shared taxonomy lets similar data be handled the same way across systems and makes rights responses and records consistent.
In Scope: Grouping personal data into categories, such as contact, financial, identifiers, or location, for consistent handling.
Out of Scope: Data classification labels for non-personal data and legal advice on edge cases.
Deliverables: A personal data category taxonomy, category tags per dataset, and mapping guidance.
Prerequisites: Personal data identification results and the privacy standard.
Lead Time: New system added to the personal data inventory within 10 business days.
SLA Response Target: Inventory question acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Inventory update within 10 business days of a change
Escalation Path: Special-category data found in a system with no approval escalates to the privacy lead and the system owner.
Threats Addressed: Inconsistent protection of similar data and wrong answers to rights requests.
KPIs and Metrics: Datasets categorized, category disputes resolved, and taxonomy updated.

Name: Special-Category Data Designation
Summary: Designate health, biometric, children's, and other special-category data and require added controls.
Description: Special-category data needs an approved use and stronger controls. Unapproved uses found in the inventory are escalated.
In Scope: Designating health, biometric, children's, and other special-category data and applying added controls.
Out of Scope: Clinical data governance, HR medical records management, and legal advice on exemptions.
Deliverables: A special-category designation list, required controls per category, and an approval record per use.
Prerequisites: Personal data inventory, legal input, and data owner engagement.
Lead Time: New system added to the personal data inventory within 10 business days.
SLA Response Target: Inventory question acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Inventory update within 10 business days of a change
Escalation Path: Special-category data found in a system with no approval escalates to the privacy lead and the system owner.
Threats Addressed: Unlawful processing of sensitive data and severe harm from exposure.
KPIs and Metrics: Special-category datasets with approval, required controls in place, and unapproved uses found.

Name: Necessity Review
Summary: Check whether each personal data field is needed for its purpose, and remove what is not.
Description: Reviews go field by field with the product owner and then verify that removed fields are actually gone.
In Scope: Reviewing whether each personal data field is needed for the stated purpose and removing what is not.
Out of Scope: Database schema redesign, product feature decisions, and lawful basis determination.
Deliverables: A necessity review record per system, a fields-to-remove list, and a follow-up verification.
Prerequisites: Field lists, purposes, and product owner input.
Lead Time: Minimization review starts within 10 business days of request.
SLA Response Target: Review request acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Review recommendation within 10 business days
Escalation Path: Retention of personal data beyond rules on a high-risk system escalates to the privacy lead and the data owner.
Threats Addressed: Over-collection, larger breach impact, and regulatory findings on minimization.
KPIs and Metrics: Fields removed, systems reviewed, and new fields challenged at design.

Name: Pseudonymization Requirements
Summary: Set when and how personal data must be pseudonymized for analytics, research, and sharing.
Description: The standard lists approved techniques and requires the re-identification key to be held separately from the data.
In Scope: Setting when and how personal data must be pseudonymized for analytics, research, and sharing.
Out of Scope: Running the pseudonymization tooling, key management operations, and data science work.
Deliverables: A pseudonymization standard, approved techniques list, and use case approvals.
Prerequisites: Use case inventory, technique options, and key separation capability.
Lead Time: Minimization review starts within 10 business days of request.
SLA Response Target: Review request acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Review recommendation within 10 business days
Escalation Path: Retention of personal data beyond rules on a high-risk system escalates to the privacy lead and the data owner.
Threats Addressed: Re-identification and exposure of identifiable data in analytics.
KPIs and Metrics: Use cases pseudonymized, re-identification test results, and exceptions approved.

Name: Personal Data Retention Rules
Summary: Set retention periods and deletion triggers for each personal data category and purpose.
Description: A personal data retention schedule tells system owners how long to keep data and what event starts deletion. Exceptions are logged.
In Scope: Retention periods for each personal data category and purpose, with deletion triggers.
Out of Scope: Records management for non-personal records, retention implementation in systems, and legal holds.
Deliverables: A personal data retention schedule, deletion triggers per purpose, and an exception log.
Prerequisites: Records of processing, legal input, and business owner needs.
Lead Time: Minimization review starts within 10 business days of request.
SLA Response Target: Review request acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Review recommendation within 10 business days
Escalation Path: Retention of personal data beyond rules on a high-risk system escalates to the privacy lead and the data owner.
Threats Addressed: Indefinite retention, larger breach impact, and regulatory findings.
KPIs and Metrics: Categories with retention rules, data past retention, and exceptions approved.

Name: Transfer Mapping
Summary: Map cross-border personal data transfers, including vendors, sub-processors, and group entities.
Description: The transfer register shows which data goes to which country and through which party, including sub-processors that are easy to miss.
In Scope: Mapping personal data transfers across borders, including vendors, sub-processors, and internal group entities.
Out of Scope: Network routing, data residency engineering, and vendor selection.
Deliverables: A transfer map, a transfer register per country, and a change report.
Prerequisites: Data maps, vendor sub-processor lists, and entity structure.
Lead Time: Transfer assessment within 15 business days of request.
SLA Response Target: Transfer question acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Transfer assessment and mechanism decision within 15 business days
Escalation Path: A transfer with no valid mechanism, or a localization breach, escalates to the privacy lead and legal immediately.
Threats Addressed: Unknown transfers to countries without adequate protection and sub-processor surprises.
KPIs and Metrics: Transfers mapped, unknown transfers found, and register freshness.

Name: Transfer Mechanism Management
Summary: Put and keep valid transfer mechanisms, such as standard contractual clauses and transfer impact assessments, in place.
Description: Each transfer has a recorded mechanism and assessment with a review date, so changes in law or vendor location are caught.
In Scope: Putting and keeping valid transfer mechanisms, such as standard contractual clauses and transfer impact assessments, in place.
Out of Scope: Drafting the underlying commercial contract and lobbying on adequacy decisions.
Deliverables: A transfer mechanism register, transfer impact assessments, and renewal reminders.
Prerequisites: Transfer map, legal templates, and vendor contacts.
Lead Time: Transfer assessment within 15 business days of request.
SLA Response Target: Transfer question acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Transfer assessment and mechanism decision within 15 business days
Escalation Path: A transfer with no valid mechanism, or a localization breach, escalates to the privacy lead and legal immediately.
Threats Addressed: Unlawful transfers, invalidated mechanisms, and regulator orders to suspend transfers.
KPIs and Metrics: Transfers with a valid mechanism, assessments current, and mechanisms past review.

Name: Data Localization Requirements
Summary: Identify where law or contract requires data to stay in a country, and turn that into technical requirements.
Description: Localization obligations are mapped to the systems they affect and checked against where the data actually sits.
In Scope: Identifying where laws or contracts require data to stay in a country and turning that into technical requirements.
Out of Scope: Building regional infrastructure, legal advice on each statute, and tax residency.
Deliverables: A localization requirements register, technical requirements per system, and a compliance check report.
Prerequisites: Legal obligations, data maps, and infrastructure owners.
Lead Time: Transfer assessment within 15 business days of request.
SLA Response Target: Transfer question acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Transfer assessment and mechanism decision within 15 business days
Escalation Path: A transfer with no valid mechanism, or a localization breach, escalates to the privacy lead and legal immediately.
Threats Addressed: Fines or business bans for unlawful data export and contract breaches.
KPIs and Metrics: Requirements mapped to systems, compliance check failures, and fixes completed.

Name: Request Intake and Verification
Summary: Receive data subject requests and verify the requester's identity proportionately before acting.
Description: Requests arrive through one portal or mailbox and are verified with methods proportionate to the risk, enough to stop impostors without blocking legitimate requests.
In Scope: Receiving data subject requests and verifying the requester's identity proportionately before acting.
Out of Scope: Customer service for non-privacy issues, fraud investigation, and account recovery.
Deliverables: A request intake form, a verification procedure, and a request log.
Prerequisites: A request portal or mailbox, verification methods, and support staff training.
Lead Time: Rights request channel available from day one. New system connected within 15 business days.
SLA Response Target: Request acknowledged within 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Request fulfilled within the legal deadline, usually 30 days
Escalation Path: A request at risk of missing its legal deadline, or from a regulator or lawyer, escalates to the privacy lead.
Threats Addressed: Disclosure to impostors, missed requests, and excessive verification that blocks rights.
KPIs and Metrics: Requests verified within 5 days, verification failures, and impostor attempts caught.

Name: Access and Portability Fulfillment
Summary: Gather a person's data from all systems and deliver it securely in a readable, portable format.
Description: A checklist covers every system in scope, and data is delivered through a secure channel to the verified requester.
In Scope: Collecting a person's data from systems and delivering it securely in a readable and portable format.
Out of Scope: Legal privilege reviews, litigation discovery, and building new export features.
Deliverables: A fulfillment checklist, a secure delivery record, and a system coverage list.
Prerequisites: Verified request, system owners, and secure delivery channel.
Lead Time: Rights request channel available from day one. New system connected within 15 business days.
SLA Response Target: Request acknowledged within 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Request fulfilled within the legal deadline, usually 30 days
Escalation Path: A request at risk of missing its legal deadline, or from a regulator or lawyer, escalates to the privacy lead.
Threats Addressed: Incomplete responses, data sent to the wrong person, and regulatory complaints.
KPIs and Metrics: Requests fulfilled on time, systems searched per request, and delivery errors.

Name: Correction and Deletion Fulfillment
Summary: Correct or delete a person's data across systems and processors and confirm completion.
Description: Deletion and correction are confirmed per system and passed on to processors, with legal holds respected.
In Scope: Correcting or deleting a person's data across systems and processors and confirming completion.
Out of Scope: Legal hold decisions, backup purging design, and account closure workflows for other reasons.
Deliverables: A deletion and correction procedure, completion confirmations per system, and processor instructions.
Prerequisites: Verified request, system integrations, and processor contacts.
Lead Time: Rights request channel available from day one. New system connected within 15 business days.
SLA Response Target: Request acknowledged within 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Request fulfilled within the legal deadline, usually 30 days
Escalation Path: A request at risk of missing its legal deadline, or from a regulator or lawyer, escalates to the privacy lead.
Threats Addressed: Data kept after deletion requests and inaccurate data harming individuals.
KPIs and Metrics: Deletions completed on time, systems missed, and processor confirmations received.

Name: Objection and Restriction Handling
Summary: Handle objections and restriction requests, such as stopping profiling or marketing, and enforce them in systems.
Description: Restriction flags in systems make sure the objection is honored, and any override is documented with its legal reason.
In Scope: Handling objections and restriction requests, such as stopping profiling or marketing, and enforcing them in systems.
Out of Scope: Marketing strategy, product feature removal, and lawful basis determination.
Deliverables: A handling procedure, restriction flags in systems, and a decision record per request.
Prerequisites: Verified request, system capability to flag records, and legal input on overrides.
Lead Time: Rights request channel available from day one. New system connected within 15 business days.
SLA Response Target: Request acknowledged within 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Request fulfilled within the legal deadline, usually 30 days
Escalation Path: A request at risk of missing its legal deadline, or from a regulator or lawyer, escalates to the privacy lead.
Threats Addressed: Processing that continues after objection and complaints to regulators.
KPIs and Metrics: Objections honored on time, overrides documented, and systems with restriction flags.

Name: Response Deadline Tracking
Summary: Track each rights request against its legal deadline, extensions, and pauses.
Description: Aging alerts reach owners well before the deadline, and extensions are sent to the requester on time.
In Scope: Tracking each rights request against its legal deadline, extensions, and pauses.
Out of Scope: Fulfilling requests, legal advice on extensions, and customer support queue management.
Deliverables: A deadline tracker, aging alerts, and extension notices.
Prerequisites: A request log with dates, deadline rules per law, and owner assignments.
Lead Time: Tracking dashboard set up within 10 business days.
SLA Response Target: Deadline risk flagged 7 days before the legal deadline
SLA Resolution Target: Monthly rights report issued by the 5th business day
Escalation Path: Any request past its legal deadline escalates to the privacy lead and legal the same day.
Threats Addressed: Missed legal deadlines and regulatory penalties.
KPIs and Metrics: Requests closed on time, requests near deadline, and extensions used.

Name: Rights Request Reporting
Summary: Report rights request volumes, types, timeliness, and trends to leadership and in public disclosures.
Description: A monthly report and an annual metrics summary come straight from the request log, so backlogs are visible and public numbers are accurate.
In Scope: Reporting rights request volumes, types, timeliness, and trends to leadership and for public disclosures.
Out of Scope: Fulfillment work, regulatory filings, and marketing reporting.
Deliverables: A monthly rights report, an annual metrics disclosure, and trend analysis.
Prerequisites: A request log, report templates, and reporting calendar.
Lead Time: Tracking dashboard set up within 10 business days.
SLA Response Target: Deadline risk flagged 7 days before the legal deadline
SLA Resolution Target: Monthly rights report issued by the 5th business day
Escalation Path: Any request past its legal deadline escalates to the privacy lead and legal the same day.
Threats Addressed: Hidden backlogs and inaccurate public disclosures.
KPIs and Metrics: Reports issued on time, data accuracy, and trend actions taken.

Name: Processor Privacy Due Diligence
Summary: Carry out privacy due diligence on vendors that process personal data, including sub-processors and transfers.
Description: Vendors are rated before contract on how they handle personal data, and approval may carry conditions. Security assessment is a separate review.
In Scope: Privacy-focused due diligence on vendors that process personal data, including sub-processors and transfers.
Out of Scope: Security assessments, commercial negotiation, and vendor selection.
Deliverables: A privacy due diligence questionnaire, a risk rating, and conditions for approval.
Prerequisites: Vendor intake, data categories involved, and vendor contacts.
Lead Time: Processor review within 10 business days of a complete intake.
SLA Response Target: Request acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Due diligence or agreement review within 10 business days
Escalation Path: A processor refusing required privacy terms, or a processor breach, escalates to the privacy lead and legal.
Threats Addressed: Processors without adequate privacy practices and unknown sub-processors.
KPIs and Metrics: Processors assessed before contract, high-risk processors, and conditions met.

Name: Data Processing Agreement Management
Summary: Draft, negotiate, and track data processing agreements and their key terms.
Description: Every processor has a signed DPA based on the standard template. Deviations are logged and renewals tracked.
In Scope: Drafting, negotiating, and tracking data processing agreements and their key terms.
Out of Scope: Commercial contract terms, procurement workflow, and litigation.
Deliverables: A DPA template, a DPA register, and a deviation log.
Prerequisites: Legal templates, contract inventory, and processor contacts.
Lead Time: Processor review within 10 business days of a complete intake.
SLA Response Target: Request acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Due diligence or agreement review within 10 business days
Escalation Path: A processor refusing required privacy terms, or a processor breach, escalates to the privacy lead and legal.
Threats Addressed: Processing without a contract and weak processor obligations.
KPIs and Metrics: Processors with a signed DPA, deviations accepted, and DPAs renewed.

Name: Processor Compliance Monitoring
Summary: Check that processors keep to their agreements, including audit reports, sub-processor changes, and incidents.
Description: Processors are reviewed on a schedule. Issues lead to corrective action requests that are tracked to closure.
In Scope: Ongoing checks that processors follow agreements, including audit reports, sub-processor changes, and incidents.
Out of Scope: Initial due diligence, vendor performance management, and contract renewal pricing.
Deliverables: A processor monitoring schedule, review records, and corrective action requests.
Prerequisites: DPA register, processor reports, and owner contacts.
Lead Time: Processor review within 10 business days of a complete intake.
SLA Response Target: Request acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Due diligence or agreement review within 10 business days
Escalation Path: A processor refusing required privacy terms, or a processor breach, escalates to the privacy lead and legal.
Threats Addressed: Processor drift from agreed terms and unnoticed sub-processor changes.
KPIs and Metrics: Processors reviewed on schedule, issues raised, and corrective actions closed.

Name: Privacy Law Applicability Analysis
Summary: Determine which privacy laws apply to each business, entity, and processing activity.
Description: An applicability matrix with recorded reasoning tells teams which obligations they must meet. It is refreshed after expansion into new markets or changes in law.
In Scope: Determining which privacy laws apply to each business, entity, and processing activity.
Out of Scope: Legal opinions for litigation and lobbying.
Deliverables: An applicability matrix, rationale per law, and a refresh log.
Prerequisites: Entity structure, processing records, and legal input.
Lead Time: Review scheduled within 20 business days of request.
SLA Response Target: Request acknowledged in 3 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Review report within 20 business days
Escalation Path: A material non-compliance finding escalates to the privacy lead, legal, and the executive sponsor.
Threats Addressed: Unknown legal obligations and wasted effort on laws that do not apply.
KPIs and Metrics: Laws assessed, entities mapped, and analysis refreshed after changes.

Name: Privacy Control Review
Summary: Test privacy controls, such as notices, consent, rights handling, and retention, for design and operation.
Description: Reviewers test samples against evidence and report controls that exist only on paper, with remediation owners.
In Scope: Testing privacy controls, such as notices, consent, rights handling, and retention, for design and operation.
Out of Scope: External certification audits, security control testing, and legal advice.
Deliverables: A privacy control review report, test results per control, and remediation actions.
Prerequisites: Control inventory, evidence access, and owner availability.
Lead Time: Review scheduled within 20 business days of request.
SLA Response Target: Request acknowledged in 3 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Review report within 20 business days
Escalation Path: A material non-compliance finding escalates to the privacy lead, legal, and the executive sponsor.
Threats Addressed: Controls that exist on paper only and audit findings.
KPIs and Metrics: Controls tested, controls failing, and remediation closed.

Name: Privacy Harm Evaluation
Summary: Evaluate the likely harm to individuals from a breach, considering data types, volume, and context.
Description: The evaluation rates risk to each affected group and recommends help such as credit monitoring. It feeds the notification threshold decision.
In Scope: Evaluating the likely harm to individuals from a breach, considering data types, volume, and context.
Out of Scope: Forensic investigation, containment, and legal liability opinions.
Deliverables: A harm evaluation record, a risk rating per affected group, and mitigation recommendations.
Prerequisites: Affected data scope, incident facts, and privacy lead availability.
Lead Time: Standing service. Engaged within 1 hour of a suspected personal data breach.
SLA Response Target: Privacy lead engaged within 2 hours of a suspected breach
SLA Resolution Target: Notification decision within 48 hours of awareness
Escalation Path: A breach likely to need regulator notice, or affecting children or special-category data, escalates to legal and the executive sponsor immediately.
Threats Addressed: Underestimating harm to individuals and failing to offer help such as credit monitoring.
KPIs and Metrics: Evaluations completed within 48 hours, ratings changed later, and mitigations offered.

Name: Breach Notification Threshold Assessment
Summary: Decide whether a breach meets the legal threshold for regulator, individual, or contractual notification.
Description: A jurisdiction-by-jurisdiction assessment sets which notices are required and by when, so deadlines are met without needless alarm.
In Scope: Assessing whether a breach meets legal thresholds for regulator, individual, or contractual notification.
Out of Scope: Writing the notices, regulator communication, and forensic analysis.
Deliverables: A threshold assessment per jurisdiction, a notification decision record, and deadline calendar.
Prerequisites: Harm evaluation, applicability matrix, and legal input.
Lead Time: Standing service. Engaged within 1 hour of a suspected personal data breach.
SLA Response Target: Privacy lead engaged within 2 hours of a suspected breach
SLA Resolution Target: Notification decision within 48 hours of awareness
Escalation Path: A breach likely to need regulator notice, or affecting children or special-category data, escalates to legal and the executive sponsor immediately.
Threats Addressed: Missed notification deadlines and over-notification that causes needless alarm.
KPIs and Metrics: Decisions within deadline, decisions reversed, and jurisdictions assessed.

Name: Regulator Breach Notification
Summary: Prepare and submit breach notifications to data protection and sector regulators.
Description: Notices are drafted from confirmed facts, submitted within deadlines such as the 72-hour GDPR window, and followed up as regulators ask questions.
In Scope: Preparing and submitting breach notifications to data protection and sector regulators.
Out of Scope: Individual notices, public relations, and litigation strategy.
Deliverables: A regulator notification, submission confirmation, and follow-up correspondence log.
Prerequisites: Notification decision, incident facts, and regulator portal access.
Lead Time: Standing service. Notification prepared once the decision is made.
SLA Response Target: Notification drafting starts within 4 hours of decision
SLA Resolution Target: Notices sent within legal deadlines, often 72 hours for regulators
Escalation Path: A notice that will miss a legal deadline escalates to legal and the executive sponsor immediately.
Threats Addressed: Late or inaccurate regulator notices and penalties.
KPIs and Metrics: Notices submitted on time, follow-up questions, and corrections needed.

Name: Individual Breach Notification
Summary: Prepare and send notices to affected individuals in plain language, with support options.
Description: Notices explain what happened, what data was involved, and what people can do, and are sent through a tracked mailing with FAQ support.
In Scope: Preparing and sending notices to affected individuals, with support options and plain-language explanation.
Out of Scope: Regulator notices, call center outsourcing contracts, and customer compensation decisions.
Deliverables: Individual notice letters or emails, a mailing record, and support FAQ.
Prerequisites: Notification decision, affected contact list, and mailing vendor.
Lead Time: Standing service. Notification prepared once the decision is made.
SLA Response Target: Notification drafting starts within 4 hours of decision
SLA Resolution Target: Notices sent within legal deadlines, often 72 hours for regulators
Escalation Path: A notice that will miss a legal deadline escalates to legal and the executive sponsor immediately.
Threats Addressed: Individuals unable to protect themselves and reputational damage from poor notices.
KPIs and Metrics: Individuals notified on time, returned notices, and support inquiries.

Name: Breach Record Keeping
Summary: Keep a record of every personal data breach, including those not notified, with facts, effects, and actions.
Description: The breach register shows regulators a complete history and lets the team spot repeat causes.
In Scope: Keeping a record of all personal data breaches, including those not notified, with facts, effects, and actions.
Out of Scope: Incident tickets for security events without personal data and legal case files.
Deliverables: A breach register, record per breach, and an annual breach summary.
Prerequisites: Incident records, decision records, and register access.
Lead Time: Standing service. Notification prepared once the decision is made.
SLA Response Target: Notification drafting starts within 4 hours of decision
SLA Resolution Target: Notices sent within legal deadlines, often 72 hours for regulators
Escalation Path: A notice that will miss a legal deadline escalates to legal and the executive sponsor immediately.
Threats Addressed: Inability to show regulators breach history and repeated breaches without learning.
KPIs and Metrics: Breaches recorded, records complete, and trends actioned.

Name: Periodic Rescreening
Summary: Repeat background checks at set intervals for roles with privileged access, finance authority, or sensitive data.
Description: Rescreening runs on a schedule by role, within the law and with employee notice. Adverse findings go to HR and the insider risk lead to decide.
In Scope: Repeating background checks at set intervals for roles with privileged access, finance authority, or sensitive data.
Out of Scope: Pre-hire screening, HR employment decisions, and screening of contractors by their employers.
Deliverables: A rescreening schedule by role, rescreening completion records, and an adverse finding referral log.
Prerequisites: A role sensitivity list, a lawful screening vendor, and employee notice and consent where needed.
Lead Time: Rescreening cycle scheduled within 20 business days of policy approval.
SLA Response Target: Screening question acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Rescreening result within 15 business days / adverse finding routed within 1 business day
Escalation Path: An adverse finding for someone with privileged or restricted access escalates to the HR lead and the insider risk lead.
Threats Addressed: Insiders whose risk changed after hiring, undisclosed convictions, and financial pressure on trusted staff.
KPIs and Metrics: Rescreenings completed on time, adverse findings referred, and roles covered.

Name: Continuous Evaluation
Summary: Run lawful, proportionate ongoing checks, such as sanctions or licensing alerts, for designated high-trust roles.
Description: Only designated roles are covered, only approved alert sources are used, and legal reviews the program. Personal social media is not monitored.
In Scope: Lawful, proportionate ongoing checks, such as sanctions or licensing alerts, for designated high-trust roles.
Out of Scope: Monitoring personal social media, productivity tracking, and HR investigations.
Deliverables: A continuous evaluation policy, alert handling records, and a legal review record.
Prerequisites: Legal approval, designated roles, and an alert source.
Lead Time: Rescreening cycle scheduled within 20 business days of policy approval.
SLA Response Target: Alert reviewed within 5 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Substantiated alert routed to HR within 1 business day of review
Escalation Path: An adverse finding for someone with privileged or restricted access escalates to the HR lead and the insider risk lead.
Threats Addressed: Undetected changes in risk for people holding critical access.
KPIs and Metrics: Alerts reviewed within 5 days, alerts substantiated, and roles covered.

Name: Self-Reporting Obligations
Summary: Set rules and a confidential channel for staff to self-report events that affect trust, such as arrests or conflicts.
Description: Staff in sensitive roles know what to report and where. Reports are handled confidentially and routed to the right reviewer.
In Scope: Rules and channels for staff to self-report events, such as arrests, foreign contacts, or conflicts, that affect trust.
Out of Scope: Investigating the reports, disciplinary decisions, and ethics hotline operation.
Deliverables: A self-reporting standard, a confidential reporting channel, and a report handling log.
Prerequisites: HR and legal approval, a confidential channel, and awareness content.
Lead Time: Rescreening cycle scheduled within 20 business days of policy approval.
SLA Response Target: Self-report acknowledged confidentially within 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Report assessed and routed within 5 business days
Escalation Path: An adverse finding for someone with privileged or restricted access escalates to the HR lead and the insider risk lead.
Threats Addressed: Hidden conflicts of interest and coercion of staff in sensitive roles.
KPIs and Metrics: Reports received, reports handled within SLA, and staff aware of obligations.

Name: Mover Access Review Trigger
Summary: Trigger an access review whenever someone changes role, department, or location.
Description: HR job change events create a manager review task, so access from the old role is removed instead of piling up.
In Scope: Triggering a review of a person's access when they change role, department, or location.
Out of Scope: Joiner and leaver provisioning, role design, and HR job change processing.
Deliverables: A mover trigger rule, a manager review task per move, and a monthly mover access report.
Prerequisites: An HR feed with job change events, an identity governance tool, and manager assignments.
Lead Time: Mover trigger built from the HR feed within 15 business days.
SLA Response Target: Mover event processed within 1 business day
SLA Resolution Target: Access review completed within 5 business days of the move
Escalation Path: A mover who keeps privileged access from the old role beyond 10 days escalates to the identity lead and the new manager.
Threats Addressed: Access accumulation across roles and toxic combinations after moves.
KPIs and Metrics: Movers reviewed within 5 days, access removed per move, and moves missed by the trigger.

Name: Role-Transfer Security Briefing
Summary: Brief people moving into roles with new security duties or sensitive access.
Description: A short, role-specific briefing covers new handling rules and reporting duties, with an acknowledgment recorded. Full training follows separately.
In Scope: A short briefing for people moving into roles with new security duties or sensitive access.
Out of Scope: Full role-based training, onboarding for new hires, and job skills training.
Deliverables: A transfer briefing checklist, a briefing acknowledgment record, and role-specific guidance.
Prerequisites: Role sensitivity list, HR mover data, and briefing content.
Lead Time: Mover trigger built from the HR feed within 15 business days.
SLA Response Target: Mover event processed within 1 business day
SLA Resolution Target: Access review completed within 5 business days of the move
Escalation Path: A mover who keeps privileged access from the old role beyond 10 days escalates to the identity lead and the new manager.
Threats Addressed: People in new roles unaware of handling rules or reporting duties.
KPIs and Metrics: Briefings completed within 10 days, acknowledgments recorded, and incidents by new movers.

Name: Departure Security Checklist Coordination
Summary: Coordinate the security steps of offboarding across IT, facilities, HR, and managers.
Description: One checklist per leaver tracks access removal, badge return, and asset recovery, so nothing depends on memory.
In Scope: Coordinating the security steps of offboarding across IT, facilities, HR, and managers.
Out of Scope: HR exit interviews, payroll, and pension processing.
Deliverables: A departure security checklist, a completion record per leaver, and an exceptions report.
Prerequisites: An HR leaver feed, checklist owners, and a tracking tool.
Lead Time: Leaver checklist triggered from the HR feed on day one.
SLA Response Target: Leaver event acknowledged within 4 business hours
SLA Resolution Target: Access removed by end of last day / assets recovered within 5 business days
Escalation Path: A leaver with unreturned devices, or a hostile departure, escalates to the HR lead and the insider risk lead the same day.
Threats Addressed: Leavers keeping access, unreturned badges, and data taken on departure.
KPIs and Metrics: Checklists complete by last day, exceptions per month, and late items.

Name: Leaver Asset Return Recovery
Summary: Recover laptops, phones, badges, tokens, and documents from leavers and confirm their condition.
Description: Returns are matched against the asset register, remote staff get courier options, and unreturned devices are wiped and escalated.
In Scope: Recovering laptops, phones, badges, tokens, and documents from leavers and confirming their state.
Out of Scope: Asset procurement, device reimaging, and legal action for unreturned items.
Deliverables: An asset return record, an unreturned asset report, and an escalation log.
Prerequisites: An asset register linked to people, a return process, and courier options for remote staff.
Lead Time: Leaver checklist triggered from the HR feed on day one.
SLA Response Target: Leaver event acknowledged within 4 business hours
SLA Resolution Target: Access removed by end of last day / assets recovered within 5 business days
Escalation Path: A leaver with unreturned devices, or a hostile departure, escalates to the HR lead and the insider risk lead the same day.
Threats Addressed: Data on unreturned devices, lost tokens, and former staff keeping badges.
KPIs and Metrics: Assets returned within 5 days, unreturned assets, and devices remotely wiped.

Name: Exit Security Briefing
Summary: Remind leavers of continuing confidentiality duties and data return obligations at exit.
Description: A short scripted briefing and a signed acknowledgment reduce disputes later about what the leaver agreed to. Enforcement is a legal matter.
In Scope: Reminding leavers of ongoing confidentiality duties and data return obligations at exit.
Out of Scope: Legal enforcement of agreements, HR exit interviews, and reference checks.
Deliverables: An exit briefing script, a signed acknowledgment, and a record of data return confirmation.
Prerequisites: HR coordination, current agreements, and briefing content.
Lead Time: Leaver checklist triggered from the HR feed on day one.
SLA Response Target: Leaver event acknowledged within 4 business hours
SLA Resolution Target: Access removed by end of last day / assets recovered within 5 business days
Escalation Path: A leaver with unreturned devices, or a hostile departure, escalates to the HR lead and the insider risk lead the same day.
Threats Addressed: Leavers taking confidential data and disputes about obligations later.
KPIs and Metrics: Briefings delivered, acknowledgments signed, and post-exit data incidents.

Name: Role-Based Security Training
Summary: Deliver training tailored to high-risk roles such as finance, HR, executives, and help desk staff.
Description: Each role learns about the attacks aimed at it, such as payment fraud or help desk impersonation, with assessments to confirm understanding.
In Scope: Training tailored to roles with specific risks, such as finance, HR, executives, and help desk staff.
Out of Scope: General workforce awareness, developer training, and professional certifications.
Deliverables: A role-based curriculum, assignment rules by role, and completion and assessment reports.
Prerequisites: A role list, a learning platform, and role owner input.
Lead Time: New curriculum module available within 30 business days of approval.
SLA Response Target: Training question acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Assigned training completed within 30 days of assignment
Escalation Path: A privileged user who has not completed required training after 60 days escalates to their manager and the access owner.
Threats Addressed: Role-specific attacks, such as payment fraud and help desk impersonation.
KPIs and Metrics: Completion rate by role, assessment scores, and incidents by trained roles.

Name: Privileged User Security Training
Summary: Train administrators and privileged users on safe admin practices, vaulting, and current attack techniques.
Description: Completion is linked to privileged access, so admins who do not finish lose elevation until they do. Vendor product certifications are separate.
In Scope: Training for administrators and privileged users on safe admin practices, vaulting, and attack techniques.
Out of Scope: Vendor product certifications, general awareness, and privileged access tool operation.
Deliverables: A privileged user curriculum, completion records linked to access, and an annual refresh.
Prerequisites: A privileged user list, learning platform, and admin practice standards.
Lead Time: New curriculum module available within 30 business days of approval.
SLA Response Target: Training question acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Assigned training completed within 30 days of assignment
Escalation Path: A privileged user who has not completed required training after 60 days escalates to their manager and the access owner.
Threats Addressed: Admin credential theft, unsafe admin habits, and misuse of elevated access.
KPIs and Metrics: Privileged users trained, access suspended for non-completion, and admin incidents.

Name: Developer Security Training
Summary: Teach secure coding with hands-on labs on common flaws, secure design, and the pipeline's own tools.
Description: Labs focus on the flaw types AppSec actually finds in the codebase, and results show whether those flaws decline.
In Scope: Secure coding training on common vulnerabilities, secure design, and the organization's pipeline tools.
Out of Scope: Application security testing, code review, and language skills training.
Deliverables: A developer training path, hands-on labs, and completion and score reports.
Prerequisites: A developer list, training platform, and AppSec input on top flaws.
Lead Time: New curriculum module available within 30 business days of approval.
SLA Response Target: Training question acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Assigned training completed within 30 days of assignment
Escalation Path: A privileged user who has not completed required training after 60 days escalates to their manager and the access owner.
Threats Addressed: Injection, broken access control, and secrets in code.
KPIs and Metrics: Developers trained, lab scores, and repeat flaw types after training.

Name: Social Engineering Testing
Summary: Run approved phishing, vishing, smishing, and physical pretext tests to measure resilience and target training.
Description: Tests follow rules of engagement agreed with HR and legal. Results drive follow-up training, not discipline. Report rate is the headline measure.
In Scope: Approved phishing, vishing, smishing, and physical pretext tests that measure resilience and target training.
Out of Scope: Real phishing triage, disciplinary action, and red team operations beyond agreed scope.
Deliverables: A test plan with rules of engagement, campaign results, and targeted follow-up training.
Prerequisites: Leadership approval, HR and legal sign-off, and a testing platform.
Lead Time: Test campaign scheduled within 15 business days of approval.
SLA Response Target: Test question acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Campaign report within 10 business days of campaign end
Escalation Path: A test that causes real business harm, or a staff complaint, escalates to the CISO and HR.
Threats Addressed: Phishing, pretext calls, and tailgating by social engineers.
KPIs and Metrics: Report rate, click rate, and repeat clickers trained.

Name: Insider Risk Program Governance
Summary: Govern the insider risk program with a charter, oversight committee, privacy safeguards, and metrics.
Description: The committee, with HR and legal members, keeps the program proportionate and lawful. Case investigation and monitoring tools are run by other services.
In Scope: Charter, oversight committee, privacy safeguards, and metrics for the insider risk program.
Out of Scope: Investigating cases, HR discipline, and technical monitoring operations.
Deliverables: An insider risk charter, oversight committee records, and an annual program review.
Prerequisites: Executive sponsor, legal and HR participation, and privacy review.
Lead Time: Program change drafted within 20 business days.
SLA Response Target: Request acknowledged in 3 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Approved criteria or charter within 30 business days
Escalation Path: Any program activity that may breach employee privacy law escalates to legal and the insider risk lead.
Threats Addressed: Unmanaged insider threats and monitoring that harms trust or breaks law.
KPIs and Metrics: Committee meetings held, program reviews completed, and privacy complaints.

Name: Insider Risk Indicator Definition
Summary: Define the technical and behavioral indicators the insider risk program watches, with legal and privacy review.
Description: Each indicator is approved before use and retired if it does not produce real cases. Building detection rules is done by the SOC.
In Scope: Defining technical and behavioral indicators the program watches for, with legal and privacy review.
Out of Scope: Building detection rules, investigating alerts, and HR performance data use beyond approval.
Deliverables: An indicator catalog, a legal review record, and indicator effectiveness notes.
Prerequisites: Program charter, data sources, and legal input.
Lead Time: Program change drafted within 20 business days.
SLA Response Target: Request acknowledged in 3 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Approved criteria or charter within 30 business days
Escalation Path: Any program activity that may breach employee privacy law escalates to legal and the insider risk lead.
Threats Addressed: Data theft by departing staff, sabotage, and fraud.
KPIs and Metrics: Indicators approved, indicators producing true cases, and indicators retired.

Name: Insider Risk Referral Criteria
Summary: Set the criteria for when an insider risk concern becomes a referral to HR, legal, or investigations.
Description: Written criteria make sure similar cases are treated the same way and serious cases are not missed.
In Scope: Criteria for when an insider risk concern becomes a referral to HR, legal, or investigations.
Out of Scope: Running the investigation, disciplinary outcomes, and law enforcement referral decisions.
Deliverables: Referral criteria, a referral decision template, and a referral log.
Prerequisites: Program charter, HR and legal agreement, and case data.
Lead Time: Program change drafted within 20 business days.
SLA Response Target: Request acknowledged in 3 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Approved criteria or charter within 30 business days
Escalation Path: Any program activity that may breach employee privacy law escalates to legal and the insider risk lead.
Threats Addressed: Inconsistent treatment of employees and missed serious cases.
KPIs and Metrics: Referrals meeting criteria, referral time, and referrals overturned.

Name: Behavioral Indicator Analysis
Summary: Analyze insider risk indicators, such as unusual downloads or access before resignation.
Description: Analysts review approved indicators under privacy safeguards, score the risk, and refer cases to triage. They make no disciplinary decisions.
In Scope: Analyst review of insider risk indicators, such as unusual downloads or access before resignation.
Out of Scope: Disciplinary decisions, HR performance reviews, and general SOC triage.
Deliverables: Indicator analysis notes, risk scores per case, and referrals to triage.
Prerequisites: Approved indicators, telemetry access, and privacy safeguards.
Lead Time: New data source added to insider analysis within 15 business days.
SLA Response Target: High-risk insider alert reviewed within 1 business day
SLA Resolution Target: Analysis complete within 5 business days
Escalation Path: A pattern suggesting imminent data theft or sabotage escalates to the insider risk lead the same day.
Threats Addressed: Data theft before departure and misuse of access.
KPIs and Metrics: Alerts analyzed within SLA, true positive rate, and referrals made.

Name: Cross-Source Risk Correlation
Summary: Correlate HR, access, endpoint, and data movement signals to raise insider risk confidence.
Description: Activity that looks harmless in one source can be significant when combined with others. Correlation uses only approved sources.
In Scope: Correlating HR, access, endpoint, and data movement signals to raise insider risk confidence.
Out of Scope: Building data pipelines, HR system administration, and case adjudication.
Deliverables: Correlation rules, combined risk scores, and correlated case summaries.
Prerequisites: Approved data sources, a correlation platform, and legal approval.
Lead Time: New data source added to insider analysis within 15 business days.
SLA Response Target: High-risk insider alert reviewed within 1 business day
SLA Resolution Target: Analysis complete within 5 business days
Escalation Path: A pattern suggesting imminent data theft or sabotage escalates to the insider risk lead the same day.
Threats Addressed: Insider activity that looks benign in a single source.
KPIs and Metrics: Correlated cases raised, false positive rate, and sources integrated.

Name: Insider Case Triage
Summary: Triage insider risk cases to decide whether to close, monitor, mitigate, or refer.
Description: Each referral gets a priority and a next-steps plan within days, so serious cases are not left waiting and minor ones are not over-investigated.
In Scope: First assessment of insider risk cases to decide close, monitor, mitigate, or refer.
Out of Scope: Full investigation, disciplinary decisions, and SOC triage of external threats.
Deliverables: A triage decision record, a case priority, and a next-steps plan.
Prerequisites: Referral details, analysis results, and triage criteria.
Lead Time: Case triaged within 1 business day of referral.
SLA Response Target: Referral acknowledged within 1 business day
SLA Resolution Target: Triage decision within 3 business days / mitigation actions within 1 business day of decision
Escalation Path: A case with imminent risk of harm or data theft escalates to legal, HR, and the incident commander.
Threats Addressed: Serious insider cases left waiting and low-risk cases over-investigated.
KPIs and Metrics: Cases triaged on time, triage outcomes, and reopened cases.

Name: Insider Risk Mitigation Actions
Summary: Apply proportionate actions to reduce insider risk, such as restricting access or increasing monitoring.
Description: Actions are approved by HR and legal and reviewed on a set date. Termination and legal action are management decisions.
In Scope: Proportionate actions to reduce insider risk, such as access restriction, monitoring increase, or manager conversation.
Out of Scope: Termination decisions, legal action, and law enforcement referral.
Deliverables: A mitigation action record, approvals, and a follow-up review date.
Prerequisites: Triage decision, HR and legal approval, and admin access.
Lead Time: Case triaged within 1 business day of referral.
SLA Response Target: Referral acknowledged within 1 business day
SLA Resolution Target: Triage decision within 3 business days / mitigation actions within 1 business day of decision
Escalation Path: A case with imminent risk of harm or data theft escalates to legal, HR, and the incident commander.
Threats Addressed: Ongoing data theft and sabotage during case handling.
KPIs and Metrics: Mitigations applied on time, repeat behavior, and actions reversed.

Name: Investigation Referral
Summary: Hand insider cases to HR, legal, or investigations with an evidence package and preserved data.
Description: The referral package and evidence index make sure nothing is lost in the handoff and the receiving team can act straight away.
In Scope: Handing cases to HR, legal, or investigations with an evidence package and preserved data.
Out of Scope: Running the investigation and deciding outcomes.
Deliverables: A referral package, an evidence index, and a handoff acknowledgment.
Prerequisites: Triage decision, preserved evidence, and receiving team availability.
Lead Time: Case triaged within 1 business day of referral.
SLA Response Target: Referral acknowledged within 1 business day
SLA Resolution Target: Triage decision within 3 business days / mitigation actions within 1 business day of decision
Escalation Path: A case with imminent risk of harm or data theft escalates to legal, HR, and the incident commander.
Threats Addressed: Evidence lost in handoff and duplicated or conflicting investigations.
KPIs and Metrics: Referrals accepted, time to handoff, and evidence gaps found.

Name: Security Culture Surveys
Summary: Survey staff attitudes, knowledge, and behavior around security.
Description: Results by department show where staff are unsure or afraid to report mistakes, and lead to specific actions.
In Scope: Periodic surveys of staff attitudes, knowledge, and behavior around security.
Out of Scope: Employee engagement surveys owned by HR and phishing simulations.
Deliverables: A survey instrument, a results report by department, and recommended actions.
Prerequisites: Survey tool, HR coordination, and leadership sponsorship.
Lead Time: Survey or metrics cycle scheduled within 20 business days.
SLA Response Target: Survey question acknowledged in 3 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Survey or metrics report within 15 business days of close
Escalation Path: A culture result showing staff fear reporting incidents escalates to the CISO and HR.
Threats Addressed: Hidden poor practices and staff afraid to report mistakes.
KPIs and Metrics: Response rate, culture index change, and actions taken.

Name: Security Behavior Metrics
Summary: Measure real security behavior, such as reporting rates, MFA adoption, and policy exceptions.
Description: A quarterly dashboard of observed behavior shows whether awareness work changes anything and where to focus next.
In Scope: Measuring real security behaviors, such as reporting rates, MFA adoption, and policy exceptions.
Out of Scope: Individual performance assessments and technical control KPIs.
Deliverables: A behavior metrics set, a quarterly behavior dashboard, and targeted interventions.
Prerequisites: Data sources from security tools and a metrics owner.
Lead Time: Survey or metrics cycle scheduled within 20 business days.
SLA Response Target: Survey question acknowledged in 3 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Survey or metrics report within 15 business days of close
Escalation Path: A culture result showing staff fear reporting incidents escalates to the CISO and HR.
Threats Addressed: Risky behavior not visible and training that does not change behavior.
KPIs and Metrics: Behavior metrics trending, interventions run, and data feed reliability.

Name: Usable Security Review
Summary: Review security controls and processes for usability so people can follow them without workarounds.
Description: Reviewers watch how controls are used, find the workarounds people invent, and recommend changes that keep the protection while removing friction.
In Scope: Reviewing security controls and processes for usability so people can follow them without workarounds.
Out of Scope: Product UX design, application development, and HR policy.
Deliverables: A usability review report, workaround findings, and recommended changes.
Prerequisites: Access to control owners, user feedback, and observation opportunities.
Lead Time: Review starts within 10 business days of request.
SLA Response Target: Request acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Review report within 10 business days
Escalation Path: A control that staff routinely bypass because it is unusable escalates to the control owner and the CISO.
Threats Addressed: Workarounds that defeat controls, shadow IT, and alert fatigue.
KPIs and Metrics: Controls reviewed, workarounds removed, and user satisfaction scores.

Name: Human Error Analysis
Summary: Analyze incidents caused by human error to find the system and process causes, not just blame.
Description: A blameless analysis finds why the mistake was easy to make, for example misdirected email or a confusing console, and recommends design fixes.
In Scope: Analyzing incidents caused by human error to find system and process causes, not just blame.
Out of Scope: Disciplinary action and technical root cause analysis.
Deliverables: An error analysis report, contributing factors, and design or process fixes.
Prerequisites: Incident records, interviews, and a blameless approach agreed by leadership.
Lead Time: Review starts within 10 business days of request.
SLA Response Target: Request acknowledged in 2 business days
SLA Resolution Target: Review report within 10 business days
Escalation Path: A control that staff routinely bypass because it is unusable escalates to the control owner and the CISO.
Threats Addressed: Repeat mistakes, misdelivery of data, and misconfiguration errors.
KPIs and Metrics: Error-driven incidents, fixes implemented, and repeat error types.

Name: Security Champions Network
Summary: Run a network of trained volunteers in business and engineering teams who promote security locally.
Description: Champions get training and a community channel and act as the first contact for their team. They extend the security team rather than replace it.
In Scope: A network of trained volunteers in business and engineering teams who promote security and act as first contact.
Out of Scope: Doing security reviews for their teams and replacing the security team.
Deliverables: A champion charter, champion roster, and monthly champion activities.
Prerequisites: Manager support, a community channel, and champion training.
Lead Time: New champion onboarded within 10 business days. Reporting channel available on day one.
SLA Response Target: Concern acknowledged within 1 business day
SLA Resolution Target: Concern routed within 1 business day / champion request answered in 5 business days
Escalation Path: A reported concern that indicates an active incident is routed to the SOC immediately.
Threats Addressed: Security disconnected from teams and late discovery of risks.
KPIs and Metrics: Champions per team, champion activity, and requests from champion teams.

Name: Security Concern Reporting Channels
Summary: Give staff easy ways to report phishing, suspicious activity, and security concerns, with feedback.
Description: A report button and a mailbox route reports to the SOC, and reporters hear back. More reports means earlier detection.
In Scope: Easy channels for staff to report phishing, suspicious activity, and security concerns, with feedback.
Out of Scope: Ethics hotline, HR grievance, and SOC alert triage.
Deliverables: A report button and mailbox, a reporting guide, and a monthly report volume summary.
Prerequisites: Email client integration, routing to the SOC, and awareness messaging.
Lead Time: New champion onboarded within 10 business days. Reporting channel available on day one.
SLA Response Target: Concern acknowledged within 1 business day
SLA Resolution Target: Concern routed within 1 business day / champion request answered in 5 business days
Escalation Path: A reported concern that indicates an active incident is routed to the SOC immediately.
Threats Addressed: Phishing not reported and incidents found late.
KPIs and Metrics: Reports per month, time to feedback, and confirmed threats from reports.

Name: Critical Process Identification
Summary: Identify the business processes whose disruption would cause serious harm and rank them.
Description: Business impact analysis workshops with each unit produce a ranked list of critical processes with confirmed owners. It is the basis for all continuity planning.
In Scope: Identifying business processes whose disruption would cause serious harm and ranking them by criticality.
Out of Scope: IT system recovery design, process improvement, and organizational design.
Deliverables: A critical process list, criticality ratings, and owner confirmations.
Prerequisites: Business unit participation, a BIA template, and leadership sponsorship.
Lead Time: BIA cycle scheduled within 20 business days.
SLA Response Target: Request acknowledged in 3 business days
SLA Resolution Target: BIA results within 20 business days of workshops
Escalation Path: A critical process without agreed recovery objectives escalates to the continuity lead and the business executive.
Threats Addressed: Disruption to critical processes because they were not known or planned for.
KPIs and Metrics: Processes rated, owners confirmed, and list reviewed annually.

Name: Recovery Objective Setting
Summary: Set recovery time and recovery point objectives for critical processes and their systems.
Description: Owners approve the RTO and RPO for each process, and the gap between objective and current capability goes to funding decisions.
In Scope: Setting recovery time and recovery point objectives for critical processes and their systems.
Out of Scope: Building the recovery capability, budget approval, and SLA contracts with vendors.
Deliverables: RTO and RPO per process, approved objectives record, and a capability gap list.
Prerequisites: Critical process list, impact data, and IT input.
Lead Time: BIA cycle scheduled within 20 business days.
SLA Response Target: Request acknowledged in 3 business days
SLA Resolution Target: BIA results within 20 business days of workshops
Escalation Path: A critical process without agreed recovery objectives escalates to the continuity lead and the business executive.
Threats Addressed: Recovery that is too slow and data loss beyond tolerance.
KPIs and Metrics: Processes with approved objectives, objectives met in tests, and gaps funded.

Name: Dependency Mapping
